ocds_schema.title: Open Contracting ID
ocds_schema.description: A globally unique identifier for this Open Contracting Process. Composed of an ocid prefix and an identifier for the contracting process. For more information see the Open Contracting Identifier guidance

ocds_schema.title: Release ID
ocds_schema.description: An identifier for this particular release of information. A release identifier must be unique within the scope of its related contracting process (defined by a common ocid). A release identifier must not contain the # character.

ocds_schema.title: Release Date
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the information contained in the release was first recorded in, or published by, any system.

ocds_schema.title: Release Tag
ocds_schema.description: One or more values from the closed releaseTag codelist. Tags can be used to filter releases and to understand the kind of information that releases might contain.
ocds_schema.values: Enum: planning, planningUpdate, tender, tenderAmendment, tenderUpdate, tenderCancellation, award, awardUpdate, awardCancellation, contract, contractUpdate, contractAmendment, implementation, implementationUpdate, contractTermination, compiled

ocds_schema.title: Initiation type
ocds_schema.description: The type of initiation process used for this contract, from the closed initiationType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Parties
ocds_schema.description: Information on the parties (organizations, economic operators and other participants) who are involved in the contracting process and their roles, e.g. buyer, procuring entity, supplier etc. Organization references elsewhere in the schema are used to refer back to this entries in this list.

ocds_schema.title: Organization
ocds_schema.description: A party (organization)

ocds_schema.title: Common name
ocds_schema.description: A common name for this organization or other participant in the contracting process. The identifier object provides a space for the formal legal name, and so this may either repeat that value, or may provide the common name by which this organization or entity is known. This field may also include details of the department or sub-unit involved in this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Entity ID
ocds_schema.description: The ID used for cross-referencing to this party from other sections of the release. This field may be built with the following structure {identifier.scheme}-{identifier.id}(-{department-identifier}).

ocds_schema.title: Primary identifier
ocds_schema.description: The primary identifier for this organization or participant. Identifiers that uniquely pick out a legal entity should be preferred. Consult the organization identifier guidance for the preferred scheme and identifier to use.

ocds_schema.title: Identifier
ocds_schema.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

ocds_schema.title: Scheme
ocds_schema.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the Organization Identifier Scheme codelist.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Legal Name
ocds_schema.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

ocds_schema.title: Additional identifiers
ocds_schema.description: A list of additional / supplemental identifiers for the organization or participant, using the organization identifier guidance. This can be used to provide an internally used identifier for this organization in addition to the primary legal entity identifier.

ocds_schema.title: Identifier
ocds_schema.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

ocds_schema.title: Scheme
ocds_schema.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the Organization Identifier Scheme codelist.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Legal Name
ocds_schema.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

ocds_schema.title: Address
ocds_schema.description: An address. This may be the legally registered address of the organization, or may be a correspondence address for this particular contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Address
ocds_schema.description: An address.

ocds_schema.title: Street address
ocds_schema.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

ocds_schema.title: Locality
ocds_schema.description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

ocds_schema.title: Region
ocds_schema.description: The region. For example, CA.

ocds_schema.title: Postal code
ocds_schema.description: The postal code. For example, 94043.

ocds_schema.title: Country name
ocds_schema.description: The country name. For example, United States.

ocds_schema.title: Contact point
ocds_schema.description: Contact details that can be used for this party.

ocds_schema.title: Contact point
ocds_schema.description: A person, contact point or department to contact in relation to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Name
ocds_schema.description: The name of the contact person, department, or contact point, for correspondence relating to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Email
ocds_schema.description: The e-mail address of the contact point/person.

ocds_schema.title: Telephone
ocds_schema.description: The telephone number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

ocds_schema.title: Fax number
ocds_schema.description: The fax number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A web address for the contact point/person.

ocds_schema.title: Party roles
ocds_schema.description: The party's role(s) in the contracting process, using the open partyRole codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Details
ocds_schema.description: Additional classification information about parties can be provided using partyDetail extensions that define particular fields and classification schemes.

ocds_schema.title: Buyer
ocds_schema.description: A buyer is an entity whose budget will be used to pay for goods, works or services related to a contract. This may be different from the procuring entity who may be specified in the tender data.

ocds_schema.title: Organization reference
ocds_schema.description: The id and name of the party being referenced. Used to cross-reference to the parties section

ocds_schema.title: Organization name
ocds_schema.description: The name of the party being referenced. This must match the name of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Organization ID
ocds_schema.description: The id of the party being referenced. This must match the id of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Primary identifier
ocds_schema.description: The primary identifier for this organization. Identifiers that uniquely pick out a legal entity should be preferred. Consult the organization identifier guidance for the preferred scheme and identifier to use.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: From version 1.1, organizations should be referenced by their identifier and name in a document, and detailed legal identifier information should only be provided in the relevant cross-referenced entry in the parties section at the top level of a release.

ocds_schema.title: Identifier
ocds_schema.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

ocds_schema.title: Scheme
ocds_schema.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the Organization Identifier Scheme codelist.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Legal Name
ocds_schema.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

ocds_schema.description: A person, contact point or department to contact in relation to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.description: The name of the contact person, department, or contact point, for correspondence relating to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Email
ocds_schema.description: The e-mail address of the contact point/person.

ocds_schema.title: Telephone
ocds_schema.description: The telephone number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

ocds_schema.title: Fax number

ocds_schema.title: URL

ocds_schema.title: Planning
ocds_schema.description: Information from the planning phase of the contracting process. This includes information related to the process of deciding what to contract, when and how.

ocds_schema.title: Planning
ocds_schema.description: Information from the planning phase of the contracting process. Note that many other fields can be filled in a planning release, in the appropriate fields in other schema sections; these would likely be estimates at this stage, e.g. value in tender.

ocds_schema.title: Rationale
ocds_schema.description: The rationale for the procurement provided in free text. More detail can be provided in an attached document.

ocds_schema.title: Budget
ocds_schema.description: Details of the budget that funds this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Budget information
ocds_schema.description: This section contains information about the budget line, and associated projects, through which this contracting process is funded. It draws upon the data model of the Fiscal Data Package, and should be used to cross-reference to more detailed information held using a Budget Data Package, or, where no linked Budget Data Package is available, to provide enough information to allow a user to manually or automatically cross-reference with another published source of budget and project information.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: An identifier for the budget line item which provides funds for this contracting process. This identifier should be possible to cross-reference against the provided data source.

ocds_schema.title: Budget Source
ocds_schema.description: A short free text description of the budget source. May be used to provide the title of the budget line, or the programme used to fund this project.

ocds_schema.title: Amount
ocds_schema.description: The value reserved in the budget for this contracting process. A negative value indicates anticipated income to the budget as a result of this contracting process, rather than expenditure. Where the budget is drawn from multiple sources, the budget breakdown extension can be used.

ocds_schema.title: Value
ocds_schema.description: Financial values should be published with a currency attached.

ocds_schema.title: Amount
ocds_schema.description: Amount as a number.

ocds_schema.title: Currency
ocds_schema.description: The currency of the amount, from the closed currency codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Project title
ocds_schema.description: The name of the project through which this contracting process is funded (if applicable). Some organizations maintain a registry of projects, and the data should use the name by which the project is known in that registry. No translation option is offered for this string, as translated values can be provided in third-party data, linked from the data source above.

ocds_schema.title: Project identifier
ocds_schema.description: An external identifier for the project that this contracting process forms part of, or is funded via (if applicable). Some organizations maintain a registry of projects, and the data should use the identifier from the relevant registry of projects.

ocds_schema.title: Linked budget information
ocds_schema.description: A URI pointing directly to a machine-readable record about the budget line-item or line-items that fund this contracting process. Information can be provided in a range of formats, including using IATI, the Open Fiscal Data Standard or any other standard which provides structured data on budget sources. Human readable documents can be included using the planning.documents block.

ocds_schema.title: Data Source
ocds_schema.description: (Deprecated in 1.1) Used to point either to a corresponding Budget Data Package, or to a machine or human-readable source where users can find further information on the budget line item identifiers, or project identifiers, provided here.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: The budget data source field was intended to link to machine-readable data about the budget for a contracting process, but has been widely mis-used to provide free-text descriptions of budget providers. As a result, it has been removed from version 1.1. budget/uri can be used to provide a link to machine-readable budget information, and budget/description can be used to provide human-readable information on the budget source.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: A list of documents related to the planning process.

ocds_schema.title: Document
ocds_schema.description: Links to, or descriptions of, external documents can be attached at various locations within the standard. Documents can be supporting information, formal notices, downloadable forms, or any other kind of resource that ought to be made public as part of full open contracting.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local, unique identifier for this document. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a document through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Document type
ocds_schema.description: A classification of the document described, using the open documentType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: The document title.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A short description of the document. Descriptions are recommended to not exceed 250 words. In the event the document is not accessible online, the description field can be used to describe arrangements for obtaining a copy of the document.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A direct link to the document or attachment. The server providing access to this document ought to be configured to correctly report the document mime type.

ocds_schema.title: Date published
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the document was first published. This is particularly important for legally important documents such as notices of a tender.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: Date that the document was last modified

ocds_schema.title: Format
ocds_schema.description: The format of the document, using the open IANA Media Types codelist (see the values in the 'Template' column), or using the 'offline/print' code if the described document is published offline. For example, web pages have a format of 'text/html'.

ocds_schema.title: Language
ocds_schema.description: The language of the linked document using either two-letter ISO639-1, or extended BCP47 language tags. The use of lowercase two-letter codes from ISO639-1 is recommended unless there is a clear user need for distinguishing the language subtype.

ocds_schema.title: Planning milestones
ocds_schema.description: A list of milestones associated with the planning stage.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone
ocds_schema.description: The milestone block can be used to represent a wide variety of events in the lifetime of a contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local identifier for this milestone, unique within this block. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a milestone through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: Milestone title

ocds_schema.title: Milestone type
ocds_schema.description: The nature of the milestone, using the open milestoneType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A description of the milestone.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone code
ocds_schema.description: Milestone codes can be used to track specific events that take place for a particular kind of contracting process. For example, a code of 'approvalLetter' can be used to allow applications to understand this milestone represents the date an approvalLetter is due or signed.

ocds_schema.title: Due date
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone is due.

ocds_schema.title: Date met
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the milestone was met.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone was last reviewed or modified and the status was altered or confirmed to still be correct.

ocds_schema.title: Status
ocds_schema.description: The status that was realized on the date provided in `dateModified`, from the closed milestoneStatus codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: List of documents associated with this milestone (Deprecated in 1.1).
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: Inclusion of documents at the milestone level is now deprecated. Documentation should be attached in the tender, award, contract or implementation sections, and titles and descriptions used to highlight the related milestone. Publishers who wish to continue to provide documents at the milestone level should explicitly declare this by using the milestone documents extension.

ocds_schema.description: The activities undertaken in order to enter into a contract.

ocds_schema.title: Tender
ocds_schema.description: Data regarding tender process - publicly inviting prospective contractors to submit bids for evaluation and selecting a winner or winners.

ocds_schema.title: Tender ID
ocds_schema.description: An identifier for this tender process. This may be the same as the ocid, or may be an internal identifier for this tender.

ocds_schema.title: Tender title
ocds_schema.description: A title for this tender. This will often be used by applications as a headline to attract interest, and to help analysts understand the nature of this procurement.

ocds_schema.title: Tender description
ocds_schema.description: A summary description of the tender. This complements any structured information provided using the items array. Descriptions should be short and easy to read. Avoid using ALL CAPS.

ocds_schema.title: Tender status
ocds_schema.description: The current status of the tender, from the closed tenderStatus codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Procurement method
ocds_schema.description: The procurement method, from the closed method codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Procurement method details
ocds_schema.description: Additional detail on the procurement method used. This field can be used to provide the local name of the particular procurement method used.

ocds_schema.title: Procurement method rationale
ocds_schema.description: Rationale for the chosen procurement method. This is especially important to provide a justification in the case of limited tenders or direct awards.

ocds_schema.title: Main procurement category
ocds_schema.description: The primary category describing the main object of this contracting process, from the closed procurementCategory codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Additional procurement categories
ocds_schema.description: Any additional categories describing the objects of this contracting process, using the open extendedProcurementCategory codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Award criteria
ocds_schema.description: The award criteria for the procurement, using the open awardCriteria codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Award criteria details
ocds_schema.description: Any detailed or further information on the award or selection criteria.

ocds_schema.title: Submission method
ocds_schema.description: The methods by which bids are submitted, using the open submissionMethod codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Submission method details
ocds_schema.description: Any detailed or further information on the submission method. This can include the address, e-mail address or online service to which bids are submitted, and any special requirements to be followed for submissions.

ocds_schema.title: Tender period
ocds_schema.description: The period when the tender is open for submissions. The end date is the closing date for tender submissions.

ocds_schema.title: Period
ocds_schema.description: Key events during a contracting process may have a known start date, end date, duration, or maximum extent (the latest date the period can extend to). In some cases, not all of these fields will have known or relevant values.

ocds_schema.title: Start date
ocds_schema.description: The start date for the period. When known, a precise start date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: End date
ocds_schema.description: The end date for the period. When known, a precise end date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: Maximum extent
ocds_schema.description: The period cannot be extended beyond this date. This field can be used to express the maximum available date for extension or renewal of this period.

ocds_schema.title: Duration (days)
ocds_schema.description: The maximum duration of this period in days. A user interface can collect or display this data in months or years as appropriate, and then convert it into days when storing this field. This field can be used when exact dates are not known. If a startDate and endDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and endDate. Otherwise, if a startDate and maxExtentDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and maxExtentDate.

ocds_schema.title: Enquiry period
ocds_schema.description: The period during which potential bidders may submit questions and requests for clarification to the entity managing procurement. Details of how to submit enquiries should be provided in attached notices, or in submissionMethodDetails. Structured dates for when responses to questions will be made can be provided using tender milestones.

ocds_schema.title: Has enquiries?

ocds_schema.title: Eligibility criteria
ocds_schema.description: A description of any eligibility criteria for potential suppliers.

ocds_schema.title: Evaluation and award period

ocds_schema.title: Number of tenderers
ocds_schema.description: The number of parties who submit a bid.

ocds_schema.title: Tenderers
ocds_schema.description: All parties who submit a bid on a tender. More detailed information on bids and the bidding organization can be provided using the bid extension.

ocds_schema.title: Organization reference
ocds_schema.description: The id and name of the party being referenced. Used to cross-reference to the parties section

ocds_schema.title: Organization name
ocds_schema.description: The name of the party being referenced. This must match the name of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Organization ID
ocds_schema.description: The id of the party being referenced. This must match the id of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Primary identifier
ocds_schema.description: The primary identifier for this organization. Identifiers that uniquely pick out a legal entity should be preferred. Consult the organization identifier guidance for the preferred scheme and identifier to use.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: From version 1.1, organizations should be referenced by their identifier and name in a document, and detailed legal identifier information should only be provided in the relevant cross-referenced entry in the parties section at the top level of a release.

ocds_schema.title: Identifier
ocds_schema.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

ocds_schema.title: Scheme
ocds_schema.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the Organization Identifier Scheme codelist.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Legal Name
ocds_schema.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

ocds_schema.title: Address
ocds_schema.description: (Deprecated outside the parties section)
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: From version 1.1, organizations should be referenced by their identifier and name in a document, and address information should only be provided in the relevant cross-referenced entry in the parties section at the top level of a release.

ocds_schema.title: Address
ocds_schema.description: An address.

ocds_schema.title: Street address
ocds_schema.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

ocds_schema.title: Locality
ocds_schema.description: The locality. For example, Mountain View.

ocds_schema.title: Region
ocds_schema.description: The region. For example, CA.

ocds_schema.title: Postal code
ocds_schema.description: The postal code. For example, 94043.

ocds_schema.title: Country name
ocds_schema.description: The country name. For example, United States.

ocds_schema.title: Additional identifiers
ocds_schema.description: (Deprecated outside the parties section) A list of additional / supplemental identifiers for the organization, using the organization identifier guidance. This can be used to provide an internally used identifier for this organization in addition to the primary legal entity identifier.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: From version 1.1, organizations should be referenced by their identifier and name in a document, and additional identifiers for an organization should be provided in the relevant cross-referenced entry in the parties section at the top level of a release.

ocds_schema.title: Contact point
ocds_schema.description: A person, contact point or department to contact in relation to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Name
ocds_schema.description: The name of the contact person, department, or contact point, for correspondence relating to this contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: Email
ocds_schema.description: The e-mail address of the contact point/person.

ocds_schema.title: Telephone
ocds_schema.description: The telephone number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

ocds_schema.title: Fax number
ocds_schema.description: The fax number of the contact point/person. This should include the international dialing code.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A web address for the contact point/person.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: All documents and attachments related to the tender, including any notices. See the documentType codelist for details of potential documents to include. Common documents include official legal notices of tender, technical specifications, evaluation criteria, and, as a tender process progresses, clarifications and replies to queries.

ocds_schema.title: Document
ocds_schema.description: Links to, or descriptions of, external documents can be attached at various locations within the standard. Documents can be supporting information, formal notices, downloadable forms, or any other kind of resource that ought to be made public as part of full open contracting.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local, unique identifier for this document. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a document through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Document type
ocds_schema.description: A classification of the document described, using the open documentType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: The document title.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A short description of the document. Descriptions are recommended to not exceed 250 words. In the event the document is not accessible online, the description field can be used to describe arrangements for obtaining a copy of the document.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A direct link to the document or attachment. The server providing access to this document ought to be configured to correctly report the document mime type.

ocds_schema.title: Date published
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the document was first published. This is particularly important for legally important documents such as notices of a tender.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: Date that the document was last modified

ocds_schema.title: Format
ocds_schema.description: The format of the document, using the open IANA Media Types codelist (see the values in the 'Template' column), or using the 'offline/print' code if the described document is published offline. For example, web pages have a format of 'text/html'.

ocds_schema.title: Language
ocds_schema.description: The language of the linked document using either two-letter ISO639-1, or extended BCP47 language tags. The use of lowercase two-letter codes from ISO639-1 is recommended unless there is a clear user need for distinguishing the language subtype.

ocds_schema.title: Milestones
ocds_schema.description: A list of milestones associated with the tender.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone
ocds_schema.description: The milestone block can be used to represent a wide variety of events in the lifetime of a contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local identifier for this milestone, unique within this block. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a milestone through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: Milestone title

ocds_schema.title: Milestone type
ocds_schema.description: The nature of the milestone, using the open milestoneType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A description of the milestone.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone code
ocds_schema.description: Milestone codes can be used to track specific events that take place for a particular kind of contracting process. For example, a code of 'approvalLetter' can be used to allow applications to understand this milestone represents the date an approvalLetter is due or signed.

ocds_schema.title: Due date
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone is due.

ocds_schema.title: Date met
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the milestone was met.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone was last reviewed or modified and the status was altered or confirmed to still be correct.

ocds_schema.title: Status
ocds_schema.description: The status that was realized on the date provided in `dateModified`, from the closed milestoneStatus codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: List of documents associated with this milestone (Deprecated in 1.1).

ocds_schema.title: Amendments
ocds_schema.description: A tender amendment is a formal change to the tender, and generally involves the publication of a new tender notice/release. The rationale and a description of the changes made can be provided here.

ocds_schema.title: Amendment
ocds_schema.description: Amendment information

ocds_schema.title: Amendment date
ocds_schema.description: The date of this amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Rationale
ocds_schema.description: An explanation for the amendment.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: An identifier for this amendment: often the amendment number

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A free text, or semi-structured, description of the changes made in this amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Amended release (identifier)
ocds_schema.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **before** the amendment was made.

ocds_schema.title: Amending release (identifier)
ocds_schema.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **after** the amendment was made.

ocds_schema.title: Amended fields
ocds_schema.description: An array of change objects describing the fields changed, and their former values. (Deprecated in 1.1)
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: A free-text or semi-structured string describing the changes made in each amendment can be provided in the amendment.description field. To provide structured information on the fields that have changed, publishers should provide releases indicating the state of the contracting process before and after the amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Property
ocds_schema.description: The property name that has been changed relative to the place the amendment is. For example if the contract value has changed, then the property under changes within the contract.amendment would be value.amount. (Deprecated in 1.1)

ocds_schema.title: Former Value
ocds_schema.description: The previous value of the changed property, in whatever type the property is. (Deprecated in 1.1)

ocds_schema.title: Amendment
ocds_schema.description: The use of individual amendment objects has been deprecated. From OCDS 1.1 information should be provided in the amendments array.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: The single amendment object has been deprecated in favour of including amendments in an amendments (plural) array.

ocds_schema.title: Awards
ocds_schema.description: Information from the award phase of the contracting process. There can be more than one award per contracting process e.g. because the contract is split among different providers, or because it is a standing offer.

ocds_schema.title: Award
ocds_schema.description: An award for the given procurement. There can be more than one award per contracting process e.g. because the contract is split among different providers, or because it is a standing offer.

ocds_schema.title: Award ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier for this award. It must be unique and must not change within the Open Contracting Process it is part of (defined by a single ocid). See the identifier guidance for further details.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: Award title

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: Award description

ocds_schema.title: Award status
ocds_schema.description: The current status of the award, from the closed awardStatus codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Award date
ocds_schema.description: The date of the contract award. This is usually the date on which a decision to award was made.

ocds_schema.title: Value
ocds_schema.description: The total value of this award. In the case of a framework contract this may be the total estimated lifetime value, or maximum value, of the agreement. There may be more than one award per procurement. A negative value indicates that the award may involve payments from the supplier to the buyer (commonly used in concession contracts).

ocds_schema.title: Value
ocds_schema.description: Financial values should be published with a currency attached.

ocds_schema.title: Amount
ocds_schema.description: Amount as a number.

ocds_schema.title: Currency
ocds_schema.description: The currency of the amount, from the closed currency codelist.

ocds_schema.description: The suppliers awarded this award. If different suppliers have been awarded different items or values, these should be split into separate award blocks.

ocds_schema.title: Organization reference
ocds_schema.description: The id and name of the party being referenced. Used to cross-reference to the parties section

ocds_schema.title: Organization name
ocds_schema.description: The name of the party being referenced. This must match the name of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Organization ID
ocds_schema.description: The id of the party being referenced. This must match the id of an entry in the parties section.

ocds_schema.title: Primary identifier
ocds_schema.description: The primary identifier for this organization. Identifiers that uniquely pick out a legal entity should be preferred. Consult the organization identifier guidance for the preferred scheme and identifier to use.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: From version 1.1, organizations should be referenced by their identifier and name in a document, and detailed legal identifier information should only be provided in the relevant cross-referenced entry in the parties section at the top level of a release.

ocds_schema.title: Identifier
ocds_schema.description: A unique identifier for a party (organization).

ocds_schema.title: Scheme
ocds_schema.description: Organization identifiers should be taken from an existing organization identifier list. The scheme field is used to indicate the list or register from which the identifier is taken. This value should be taken from the Organization Identifier Scheme codelist.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The identifier of the organization in the selected scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Legal Name
ocds_schema.description: The legally registered name of the organization.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to identify the organization, such as those provided by Open Corporates or some other relevant URI provider. This is not for listing the website of the organization: that can be done through the URL field of the Organization contact point.

ocds_schema.title: Postal code

ocds_schema.title: Country name

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local identifier to reference and merge the items by. Must be unique within a given array of items.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A description of the goods, services to be provided.

ocds_schema.title: Classification
ocds_schema.description: The primary classification for the item.

ocds_schema.title: Scheme

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: The classification code taken from the scheme.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A textual description or title for the classification code.

ocds_schema.title: URI
ocds_schema.description: A URI to uniquely identify the classification code.

ocds_schema.title: Additional classifications

ocds_schema.title: Contract period
ocds_schema.description: The period for which the contract has been awarded.

ocds_schema.title: Period
ocds_schema.description: Key events during a contracting process may have a known start date, end date, duration, or maximum extent (the latest date the period can extend to). In some cases, not all of these fields will have known or relevant values.

ocds_schema.title: Start date
ocds_schema.description: The start date for the period. When known, a precise start date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: End date
ocds_schema.description: The end date for the period. When known, a precise end date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: Maximum extent
ocds_schema.description: The period cannot be extended beyond this date. This field can be used to express the maximum available date for extension or renewal of this period.

ocds_schema.title: Duration (days)
ocds_schema.description: The maximum duration of this period in days. A user interface can collect or display this data in months or years as appropriate, and then convert it into days when storing this field. This field can be used when exact dates are not known. If a startDate and endDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and endDate. Otherwise, if a startDate and maxExtentDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and maxExtentDate.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: All documents and attachments related to the award, including any notices.

ocds_schema.title: Document
ocds_schema.description: Links to, or descriptions of, external documents can be attached at various locations within the standard. Documents can be supporting information, formal notices, downloadable forms, or any other kind of resource that ought to be made public as part of full open contracting.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local, unique identifier for this document. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a document through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Document type
ocds_schema.description: A classification of the document described, using the open documentType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: The document title.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A short description of the document. Descriptions are recommended to not exceed 250 words. In the event the document is not accessible online, the description field can be used to describe arrangements for obtaining a copy of the document.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A direct link to the document or attachment. The server providing access to this document ought to be configured to correctly report the document mime type.

ocds_schema.title: Date published
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the document was first published. This is particularly important for legally important documents such as notices of a tender.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: Date that the document was last modified

ocds_schema.title: Format
ocds_schema.description: The format of the document, using the open IANA Media Types codelist (see the values in the 'Template' column), or using the 'offline/print' code if the described document is published offline. For example, web pages have a format of 'text/html'.

ocds_schema.title: Language
ocds_schema.description: The language of the linked document using either two-letter ISO639-1, or extended BCP47 language tags. The use of lowercase two-letter codes from ISO639-1 is recommended unless there is a clear user need for distinguishing the language subtype.

ocds_schema.description: The start date for the period. When known, a precise start date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: End date
ocds_schema.description: The end date for the period. When known, a precise end date must be provided.

ocds_schema.title: Maximum extent
ocds_schema.description: The period cannot be extended beyond this date. This field can be used to express the maximum available date for extension or renewal of this period.

ocds_schema.title: Duration (days)
ocds_schema.description: The maximum duration of this period in days. A user interface can collect or display this data in months or years as appropriate, and then convert it into days when storing this field. This field can be used when exact dates are not known. If a startDate and endDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and endDate. Otherwise, if a startDate and maxExtentDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and maxExtentDate.

ocds_schema.title: Value
ocds_schema.description: The total value of this contract. A negative value indicates that the contract will involve payments from the supplier to the buyer (commonly used in concession contracts).

ocds_schema.title: Value
ocds_schema.description: Financial values should be published with a currency attached.

ocds_schema.title: Amount
ocds_schema.description: Amount as a number.

ocds_schema.title: Currency
ocds_schema.description: The currency of the amount, from the closed currency codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Provider organization
ocds_schema.description: (Deprecated in 1.1. Use transaction.payer instead.) The Organization Identifier for the organization from which the funds in this transaction originate. Expressed following the Organizational Identifier standard - consult the documentation and the codelist.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: This field has been replaced by the `transaction.payer` field to resolve ambiguity arising from 'provider' being interpreted as relating to the goods or services procured rather than the flow of funds between the parties.

ocds_schema.title: Milestones
ocds_schema.description: As milestones are completed, the milestone's status and dates should be updated.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone
ocds_schema.description: The milestone block can be used to represent a wide variety of events in the lifetime of a contracting process.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local identifier for this milestone, unique within this block. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a milestone through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: Milestone title

ocds_schema.title: Milestone type
ocds_schema.description: The nature of the milestone, using the open milestoneType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A description of the milestone.

ocds_schema.title: Milestone code
ocds_schema.description: Milestone codes can be used to track specific events that take place for a particular kind of contracting process. For example, a code of 'approvalLetter' can be used to allow applications to understand this milestone represents the date an approvalLetter is due or signed.

ocds_schema.title: Due date
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone is due.

ocds_schema.title: Date met
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the milestone was met.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: The date the milestone was last reviewed or modified and the status was altered or confirmed to still be correct.

ocds_schema.title: Status
ocds_schema.description: The status that was realized on the date provided in `dateModified`, from the closed milestoneStatus codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Documents
ocds_schema.description: List of documents associated with this milestone (Deprecated in 1.1).
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: Inclusion of documents at the milestone level is now deprecated. Documentation should be attached in the tender, award, contract or implementation sections, and titles and descriptions used to highlight the related milestone. Publishers who wish to continue to provide documents at the milestone level should explicitly declare this by using the milestone documents extension.

ocds_schema.title: Document
ocds_schema.description: Links to, or descriptions of, external documents can be attached at various locations within the standard. Documents can be supporting information, formal notices, downloadable forms, or any other kind of resource that ought to be made public as part of full open contracting.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: A local, unique identifier for this document. This field is used to keep track of multiple revisions of a document through the compilation from release to record mechanism.

ocds_schema.title: Document type
ocds_schema.description: A classification of the document described, using the open documentType codelist.

ocds_schema.title: Title
ocds_schema.description: The document title.

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A short description of the document. Descriptions are recommended to not exceed 250 words. In the event the document is not accessible online, the description field can be used to describe arrangements for obtaining a copy of the document.

ocds_schema.title: URL
ocds_schema.description: A direct link to the document or attachment. The server providing access to this document ought to be configured to correctly report the document mime type.

ocds_schema.title: Date published
ocds_schema.description: The date on which the document was first published. This is particularly important for legally important documents such as notices of a tender.

ocds_schema.title: Date modified
ocds_schema.description: Date that the document was last modified

ocds_schema.title: Format
ocds_schema.description: The format of the document, using the open IANA Media Types codelist (see the values in the 'Template' column), or using the 'offline/print' code if the described document is published offline. For example, web pages have a format of 'text/html'.

ocds_schema.title: Language
ocds_schema.description: The language of the linked document using either two-letter ISO639-1, or extended BCP47 language tags. The use of lowercase two-letter codes from ISO639-1 is recommended unless there is a clear user need for distinguishing the language subtype.

ocds_schema.title: Amendments
ocds_schema.description: A contract amendment is a formal change to, or extension of, a contract, and generally involves the publication of a new contract notice/release, or some other documents detailing the change. The rationale and a description of the changes made can be provided here.

ocds_schema.title: Amendment
ocds_schema.description: Amendment information

ocds_schema.title: Amendment date
ocds_schema.description: The date of this amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Rationale
ocds_schema.description: An explanation for the amendment.

ocds_schema.title: ID
ocds_schema.description: An identifier for this amendment: often the amendment number

ocds_schema.title: Description
ocds_schema.description: A free text, or semi-structured, description of the changes made in this amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Amended release (identifier)
ocds_schema.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **before** the amendment was made.

ocds_schema.title: Amending release (identifier)
ocds_schema.description: Provide the identifier (release.id) of the OCDS release (from this contracting process) that provides the values for this contracting process **after** the amendment was made.

ocds_schema.title: Amended fields
ocds_schema.description: An array of change objects describing the fields changed, and their former values. (Deprecated in 1.1)
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: A free-text or semi-structured string describing the changes made in each amendment can be provided in the amendment.description field. To provide structured information on the fields that have changed, publishers should provide releases indicating the state of the contracting process before and after the amendment.

ocds_schema.title: Property
ocds_schema.description: The property name that has been changed relative to the place the amendment is. For example if the contract value has changed, then the property under changes within the contract.amendment would be value.amount. (Deprecated in 1.1)

ocds_schema.title: Former Value
ocds_schema.description: The previous value of the changed property, in whatever type the property is. (Deprecated in 1.1)

ocds_schema.title: Amendment
ocds_schema.description: The use of individual amendment objects has been deprecated. From OCDS 1.1 information should be provided in the amendments array.
ocds_schema.deprecationnotes: The single amendment object has been deprecated in favour of including amendments in an amendments (plural) array.

ocds_extensions.description: The location where activity related to this tender, contract or license will be delivered, or will take place. A location can be described by either a geometry (point location, line or polygon), or a gazetteer entry, or both.

ocds_extensions.title: Description
ocds_extensions.description: A name or description of this location. This might include the name(s) of the location(s), or might provide a human-readable description of the location to be covered.

ocds_extensions.title: Gazetteer scheme
ocds_extensions.description: The identifier of the gazetteer. The `locationGazetteers.csv` codelist provides details of services, where available, that can resolve a gazetteer entry to provide location names.

ocds_extensions.title: Geometry
ocds_extensions.description: We follow the GeoJSON standard to express basic location information, using longitude, latitude, and optional elevation values in the WGS84 (EPSG:4326) projection. A point location can be identified by geocoding a delivery address. For concession licenses, or other contracts covering a polygon location which is not contained in a known gazetteer, polygon and multi-polygon can be used.

ocds_extensions.title: Coordinates
ocds_extensions.description: The relevant array of points, e.g. [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation], or a nested array of points, for the GeoJSON geometry being described. The longitude and latitude must be expressed in decimal degrees in the WGS84 (EPSG:4326) projection.

ocds_extensions.title: Type
ocds_extensions.description: The type of GeoJSON Geometry Objects being provided. To provide longitude, latitude, and optional elevation, use 'Point', and enter an array of [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation] as the value of the coordinates field: e.g. [-122.085, 37.42].
ocds_extensions.values: Enum: Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon

ocds_extensions.title: Related lot(s)
ocds_extensions.description: A list of the identifiers of the lots that form this group. Lots can appear in more than one group.

ocds_extensions.title: Lots
ocds_extensions.description: A tender process can be divided into lots, where bidders can bid on one or more lots. Details of each lot can be provided here. Items, documents and other features may then reference the lot they are related to using relatedLot. Where no relatedLots identifier is given, the values ought to be interpreted as applicable to the whole tender. Properties of tender can be overridden for a given Lot through their inclusion in the Lot object.

ocds_extensions.title: Lots
ocds_extensions.description: A lot is a grouping of items within a tender that can be bid on or awarded together.

ocds_extensions.title: Contract period
ocds_extensions.description: The period over which the contract is estimated or specified to be active. If the lot does not specify explicit dates, the duration field can be used.

ocds_extensions.title: Period
ocds_extensions.description: Key events during a contracting process may have a known start date, end date, duration, or maximum extent (the latest date the period can extend to). In some cases, not all of these fields will have known or relevant values.

ocds_extensions.title: Duration (days)
ocds_extensions.description: The maximum duration of this period in days. A user interface can collect or display this data in months or years as appropriate, and then convert it into days when storing this field. This field can be used when exact dates are not known. If a startDate and endDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and endDate. Otherwise, if a startDate and maxExtentDate are set, this field, if used, should be equal to the difference between startDate and maxExtentDate.

ocds_extensions.title: End date
ocds_extensions.description: The end date for the period. When known, a precise end date must be provided.

ocds_extensions.title: Maximum extent
ocds_extensions.description: The period cannot be extended beyond this date. This field can be used to express the maximum available date for extension or renewal of this period.

ocds_extensions.title: Start date
ocds_extensions.description: The start date for the period. When known, a precise start date must be provided.

ocds_extensions.title: Description
ocds_extensions.description: A description of this lot.

ocds_extensions.title: Lot ID
ocds_extensions.description: A local identifier for this lot, such as a lot number. This is used in relatedLots references at the item, document and award level.

ocds_extensions.title: Lot Status
ocds_extensions.description: The current status of the process related to this lot.
ocds_extensions.values: Enum: planning, planned, active, cancelled, unsuccessful, complete, withdrawn
